description: Search US land on Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet): land for sale and every other property on the network, mostly vacant lots and acreage. Returns a list of properties matching the given filters (location, size, Property checks, listing status, listing price and price per acre, distance from a point), sorted by price, price per acre, acres, estimated value, Property checks, mint date or distance; each row carries its price per acre (listing or estimate, labelled) and, with near, its straight-line distance. Or counts per state or county with groupBy. When a state or county is given, the response includes the link to that location's page on fabrica.land. Each result is a real parcel of land in the US, held in a trust whose beneficial interest is an ERC-1155 token.

county.description: County name, case-insensitive, the 'County' suffix optional (e.g. 'Costilla' or 'Mohave County'). Combine with region when the name exists in more than one state.

groupBy.description: Return one row per state or county (property count, count for sale, total acres, location page link) instead of property rows. limit and offset page through the groups.

hasListings.description: Only show properties with active sale listings

hasLoans.description: Only show properties with active loans

maxPrice.description: Maximum listing price in USD. Only listed properties match any price filter.

maxPricePerAcre.description: Maximum listing price per acre in USD (listing price over acres; unlisted properties never match).

minPrice.description: Minimum listing price in USD. Only listed properties match any price filter.

minPricePerAcre.description: Minimum listing price per acre in USD (listing price over acres; unlisted properties never match).

minScore.description: Minimum Property checks number: the 5-digit numeric encoding of Property checks, an integer. Defaults to 72032, the marketplace threshold, except when ownedBy is set (then every property in that wallet is listed). Any minimum also requires a verified deed. Max: 75342.

near.description: A point to measure distance from, in decimal degrees. Each row then carries distanceMiles (straight-line), and the default sort is by distance.

radiusMiles.description: Keep only properties within this many miles of the point (default: no limit, every row gets its distance).

sortBy.description: Order of the rows. price and pricePerAcre use the listing price and put unlisted properties last; newest is by mint date; distance needs near. Default: the API's order, or distance when near is set.

sortDir.description: asc (default) or desc. newest is always most recent first.

name: search_land
title: Search land
